question: Under US federal law, can a manufacturer void a product warranty just because the customer used a third-party repair shop or parts?
ground_truth: Generally no. Per the FTC (Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act guidance on ftc.gov), a warrantor can't void a warranty or deny coverage solely because a customer used third-party parts or service, unless they provide those free or have an FTC waiver; they can deny coverage if the third-party part/service caused the damage.
